title: Check: Comparing Aerobic and Anaerobic Respiration (Part 2)

questions.stem: During a 400m sprint, an athlete uses both aerobic and anaerobic respiration. Why does the body use both types?

options.text: Aerobic respiration provides energy at the start, then stops completely
Anaerobic respiration supplements aerobic when oxygen supply cannot meet demand
The body randomly switches between the two types
Anaerobic respiration is used for leg muscles while aerobic is used for arm muscles

questions.explanation: During intense exercise, aerobic respiration continues but cannot supply enough energy alone. Anaerobic respiration provides additional energy when oxygen delivery to muscles cannot keep up with demand.
